topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Hey, I totally get why you're asking, and I mean, growing your own stuff is amazing, it really is. But, uh, I'm really trying to get everything in order here, you know? The yard’s been a bit of a project, and I feel like if I say yes, it might just, like, complicate things. I’m trying to find my own rhythm with all this, and I’m not sure if I can manage a shared space right now. I hope you understand! Maybe there’s another spot nearby that could work? I’m so rooting for your garden, truly. Let’s keep talking about this, okay?
